models.title: Subway_[interior]
models.author: Comicaroid (@yuuuusukeeee)
models.attribution_line: "Subway_[interior]" by Comicaroid (@yuuuusukeeee), https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/subway-interior-b7f25426ac674a9291ba092fb9fe8406 , licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
changes: the model's outer shell, the posters and frames on its walls and its door leaves are not used
the remaining parts are cut along the car into end, door and seat-bay modules and re-assembled to a 4-door, 20 m layout (doors at x = +-2.3 m and +-6.7 m)
scaled across the car by 0.90 and in height by 0.868; door modules by 0.79 and seat bays by 0.81 along the car; floor 1.15 m above rail top
a few hundred vertices per car near the roof edge moved down so that everything stays inside the car body
materials replaced by scene materials (seat colour kept from the model)
8 variants (one per car body type) used by 68 car instances through the car master collections
